episodes.title: Good News About Hell
episodes.summary: Mark is promoted to lead a team who've had their memories surgically divided between their work and personal lives.

episodes.title: Half Loop
episodes.summary: The team train new hire Helly on macrodata refinement. Mark takes a day off to meet with a mysterious former colleague.

episodes.title: In Perpetuity
episodes.summary: Mark takes the team on a field trip, but Helly continues to rebel. A deteriorating Petey struggles to tell Mark about Lumon's misdeeds.

episodes.title: The You You Are

episodes.title: The Grim Barbarity of Optics and Design
episodes.summary: Irving and Dylan confront Burt about his lies. Mark and Helly discover a strange new department.

episodes.title: Hide and Seek
episodes.summary: The team angers Cobel by forming an alliance.

episodes.title: Defiant Jazz
episodes.summary: Mark and the team encounter new security measures from Cobel.

episodes.title: What's for Dinner?
episodes.summary: The team prepares a plan. Mark attends Devon and Ricken's party.

episodes.title: The We We Are
episodes.summary: Season finale. The team discovers troubling revelations.

episodes.title: Hello, Ms. Cobel
episodes.summary: Mark returns to work under different circumstances. Secrets from the Outie world come to light.

episodes.title: Goodbye, Mrs. Selvig
episodes.summary: Outie Mark contemplates the meaning of a message. Lumon grapples with the fallout of the Overtime Contingency.

episodes.title: Who Is Alive?
episodes.summary: Mark, Helly, Irving, and Dylan search for answers.

episodes.title: Woe's Hollow
episodes.summary: The team participates in a group activity.

episodes.title: Trojan's Horse
episodes.summary: Tensions emerge after the team suffers a loss.

episodes.title: Attila
episodes.summary: Bonds are tested. Mark continues on his path of discovery.

episodes.title: Chikhai Bardo
episodes.summary: An old romance intersects with a deadly present threat.

episodes.title: The After Hours
episodes.summary: Mark and Devon team with an ally. Helly investigates further.

episodes.title: Cold Harbor
episodes.summary: Season finale. Mark forms a shaky alliance in an all-or-nothing play, while the team makes a dangerous last stand.
